title_en: I want you to … / I told you to …
title_vi: I want you to … / I told you to … (muốn ai / bảo ai làm gì)
theory_html:
A. I want you to …

A. I want you to … (tôi muốn bạn …)

The woman wants to go. The man doesn’t want the woman to go. He wants her to stay.

Người phụ nữ muốn đi. Người đàn ông không muốn cô ấy đi. Anh ấy muốn cô ấy ở lại.

We say: I want to do something / I want you / somebody / Sarah to do something

Ta nói: I want to do something / I want you / somebody / Sarah to do something

  • I want you to be happy. (not I want that you are happy)

    Tôi muốn bạn hạnh phúc. (không nói I want that you are happy)

  • They didn’t want anybody to know their secret.

    Họ không muốn ai biết bí mật của họ.

  • Do you want me to lend you some money?

    Bạn có muốn tôi cho bạn mượn ít tiền không?

We use would like in the same way:

Dùng would like theo cách tương tự:

  • Would you like me to lend you some money?

    Bạn có muốn tôi cho bạn mượn ít tiền không?

B. ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …

B. ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …

  • Sue asked a friend to lend her some money.

    Sue nhờ một người bạn cho cô ấy mượn ít tiền.

  • I told you to be careful.

    Tôi đã bảo bạn phải cẩn thận.

  • What do you advise me to do?

    Bạn khuyên tôi nên làm gì?

  • I didn’t expect them to be here.

    Tôi không ngờ họ lại ở đây.

  • We persuaded Gary to come with us.

    Chúng tôi thuyết phục Gary đi cùng.

  • I am teaching my brother to swim.

    Tôi đang dạy em trai tôi bơi.

C. I told you to … / I told you not to …

C. I told you to … / I told you not to … (bảo ai làm / đừng làm gì)

  • Jane: ‘Wait for me.’ → Jane told me to wait for her.

    Jane: ‘Đợi tôi nhé.’ → Jane bảo tôi đợi cô ấy.

  • Paul: ‘Don’t wait for me.’ → Paul told Sue not to wait for him.

    Paul: ‘Đừng đợi tôi.’ → Paul bảo Sue đừng đợi anh ấy.

D. make and let

D. make và let

After make and let, we do not use to:

Sau make và let, không dùng to:

  • He’s very funny. He makes me laugh. (not makes me to laugh)

    Anh ấy rất vui tính. Anh ấy làm tôi cười. (không nói makes me to laugh)

  • At school our teacher made us work very hard.

    Ở trường thầy giáo bắt chúng tôi học rất chăm.

  • I didn’t have my phone with me, so Sue let me use hers. (not let me to use)

    Tôi không mang điện thoại, nên Sue cho tôi dùng máy của cô ấy. (không nói let me to use)

You can say Let’s … (= Let us) when you want people to do things with you:

Có thể nói Let’s … (= Let us) khi muốn người khác cùng làm gì với mình:

  • Come on! Let’s dance.

    Nào! Nhảy đi.

  • ‘Do you want to go out tonight?’ ‘No, I’m tired. Let’s stay at home.’

    ‘Tối nay bạn muốn ra ngoài không?’ ‘Không, tôi mệt. Ở nhà đi.’

mcq.question: The man doesn’t want the woman ___.
mcq.full: The man doesn’t want the woman to go.
mcq.vi: Người đàn ông không muốn cô ấy đi.
mcq.expl:
want / would like + somebody + to … (not want that …).
want / would like + ai + to … (không nói want that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: want + ai + to.
mcq.key: The man doesn’t want the woman ___.|to go

mcq.question: I want you ___ happy.
mcq.full: I want you to be happy.
mcq.vi: Tôi muốn bạn hạnh phúc.
mcq.expl:
want / would like + somebody + to … (not want that …).
want / would like + ai + to … (không nói want that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không nói I want that you are happy.
mcq.key: I want you ___ happy.|to be

mcq.expl:
want / would like + somebody + to … (not want that …).
want / would like + ai + to … (không nói want that …).
Điểm ngữ pháp: want + anybody + to.
mcq.key: They didn’t want anybody ___ their secret.|to know

want / would like + ai + to … (không nói want that …).

mcq.full: Laura had a lot of luggage. She asked me to help her.

mcq.expl:
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …

mcq.key: Laura had a lot of luggage. She asked me ___ her.|to help

mcq.question: Amy’s mother taught her ___ the piano.
mcq.full: Amy’s mother taught her to play the piano.
mcq.vi: Mẹ Amy dạy cô ấy chơi piano.
mcq.expl:
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …
Điểm ngữ pháp: teach + her + to.
mcq.key: Amy’s mother taught her ___ the piano.|to play

mcq.question: I didn’t hear what she said, so I asked her ___ it.
mcq.full: I didn’t hear what she said, so I asked her to repeat it.
mcq.vi: Tôi không nghe cô ấy nói gì, nên nhờ cô ấy nhắc lại.
mcq.expl:
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + her + to.
mcq.key: I didn’t hear what she said, so I asked her ___ it.|to repeat

mcq.question: Are they already here? I expected them ___ much later.
mcq.full: Are they already here? I expected them to arrive much later.
mcq.vi: Họ đến rồi à? Tôi tưởng họ đến muộn hơn nhiều.
mcq.expl:
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …
Điểm ngữ pháp: expect + them + to.
mcq.key: Are they already here? I expected them ___ much later.|to arrive

mcq.full: Rachel can’t come to the party. She told me to tell you.
mcq.vi: Rachel không đến bữa tiệc được. Cô ấy bảo tôi nói với bạn.
mcq.expl:
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + somebody + to …
ask / tell / advise / expect / persuade / teach + ai + to …
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + me + to.
mcq.key: Rachel can’t come to the party. She told me ___ you.|to tell

mcq.question: Jane: ‘Wait for me.’ → Jane told me ___ for her.
mcq.full: Jane: ‘Wait for me.’ → Jane told me to wait for her.
mcq.vi: Jane: ‘Đợi tôi nhé.’ → Jane bảo tôi đợi cô ấy.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody to … / tell somebody not to …
tell somebody to … (bảo ai làm) / tell somebody not to … (bảo ai đừng làm).
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + ai + to.
mcq.key: Jane: ‘Wait for me.’ → Jane told me ___ for her.|to wait

mcq.full: Paul: ‘Don’t wait for me.’ → Paul told Sue not to wait for him.

mcq.expl:
tell somebody to … / tell somebody not to …
tell somebody to … (bảo ai làm) / tell somebody not to … (bảo ai đừng làm).
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + ai + not to.
mcq.key: Paul: ‘Don’t wait for me.’ → Paul told Sue ___ for him.|not to wait

mcq.question: I wanted to get to the station. A woman told me ___ left after the bridge.
mcq.full: I wanted to get to the station. A woman told me to turn left after the bridge.
mcq.vi: Tôi muốn đến nhà ga. Một phụ nữ bảo tôi rẽ trái sau cây cầu.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody to … / tell somebody not to …
tell somebody to … (bảo ai làm) / tell somebody not to … (bảo ai đừng làm).
Điểm ngữ pháp: told me to.
mcq.key: I wanted to get to the station. A woman told me ___ left after the bridge.|to turn

mcq.question: I was too busy to talk to Tom. I told him ___ back in ten minutes.
mcq.full: I was too busy to talk to Tom. I told him to come back in ten minutes.
mcq.vi: Tôi quá bận để nói chuyện với Tom. Tôi bảo anh ấy mười phút nữa quay lại.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody to … / tell somebody not to …
tell somebody to … (bảo ai làm) / tell somebody not to … (bảo ai đừng làm).
Điểm ngữ pháp: told him to.
mcq.key: I was too busy to talk to Tom. I told him ___ back in ten minutes.|to come

mcq.vi: Sue định gọi cho tôi sau. Tôi bảo cô ấy đừng gọi trước 8 giờ.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody to … / tell somebody not to …
tell somebody to … (bảo ai làm) / tell somebody not to … (bảo ai đừng làm).
Điểm ngữ pháp: told her not to.
mcq.key: Sue is going to call me later. I told her ___ before 8 o’clock.|not to phone

mcq.question: He’s very funny. He makes me ___.
mcq.full: He’s very funny. He makes me laugh.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy rất vui tính. Anh ấy làm tôi cười.
mcq.expl:
make / let + somebody + infinitive without to; Let’s + infinitive.
make / let + ai + nguyên mẫu không to; Let’s + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: make + ai + nguyên mẫu (không to).
mcq.key: He’s very funny. He makes me ___.|laugh

mcq.expl:
make / let + somebody + infinitive without to; Let’s + infinitive.
make / let + ai + nguyên mẫu không to; Let’s + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: make + us + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: At school our teacher made us ___ very hard.|work

make / let + somebody + infinitive without to; Let’s + infinitive.

mcq.expl:
make / let + somebody + infinitive without to; Let’s + infinitive.
make / let + ai + nguyên mẫu không to; Let’s + nguyên mẫu.

make / let + somebody + infinitive without to; Let’s + infinitive.
